note: Goblin tribes and their camps (Dave 19 Nov 2026: "build them a goblin camp somewhere near the river or in a cave. I want the goblins to be apprehensive but willing to communicate and trade/buy and sell. in the future the game will have various goblin tribes/camps etc that are friendly, not friendly, indifferent etc."; "the goblin camp could be a cave somewhere near a river"). Read by src/stream/server_tribes.gd (behaviour, standing, anger) and src/stream/server_npcs.gd (the members and their spots). A tribe names its attitude; every number of an attitude is in its row below, so a friendly, unfriendly or hostile tribe later is a new tribes row, not new code. Standing is kept per tribe (rep_key, the same reputation as Hob's: data/npcs/reputation.json ranks), so every goblin and every camp of a tribe knows a character the same. keep_m: how far a member stays from a character of that rank (the trader lets them closer: trader_keep_m); spook_m: inside this a character who runs (faster than rush_mps) or carries a weapon on the hotbar makes them back off by armed_keep_m more; leash_m: how far from its spot a member backs off before it holds its ground; watch_m: inside this they turn to watch. trades: false refuses all trade (an unfriendly or hostile tribe). anger_game_days: a character who strikes a member is refused and kept off at angry_keep_m that long (Dave's side, 19 Nov 2026, answered for him: unkillable for now; the tribe turns on that player and stops trading with them for a few days). trade_rep: standing a completed deal earns, at most once a game day (trade_rep_every_game_days). ALL NUMBERS AND NAMES PROVISIONAL (GOBLIN-1..GOBLIN-8 in docs/design/GOBLIN_CAMP.md).

camp.note: At the mouth of spring cave 3,4#8013, about 2.8 km east of Edda and Hob's camp; its river runs 50 m west of the mouth (read from the baked tile 3_4 on 19 Nov 2026: mouth x 56064 z 68384, ground about 71 m, a bench of 13-20 degrees runs east of the mouth along the hill). The fire and the members stand on that bench 6-16 m east of the mouth, clear of the opening (the hill's ground is not cut there), the trader facing west, the way a player comes up from the river. The tunnels inside stay as they are (the caves plan). mouth: where members go out of sight when an angry character comes near. keep_m: nothing is put down this near the fire.
